analyst_view.overall: Early view: with a month to go, Brann (7th, seven points) host Braga (17th, four points) on matchday 5. Brann's season has been open (45 goals for and 42 against in 25 Eliteserien games) and they are unbeaten in Europe; Braga are eighth in Portugal with low-scoring games (13 for, 11 against in 11). Brann's league season may have ended by then, which could affect sharpness.
